purpose: Teach: 珪/聾/鞍/烏/瑤/螢/禄/鄭

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、半導体の珪素、つまり珪の結晶構造研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on semiconductor silicon crystal structure research, wasn't it.
lines.style: Calm, measured opening. Light curiosity in the lift. Patient pacing—teacher checking in, not testing. Warm attention on his name.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、聾、つまり聴覚障害の医学社会学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I covered medical sociology research on deafness and hearing disability.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. Clear articulation. A small pause before the pivot—gathering himself to correct the assumption. Earnest but not defensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、馬具の鞍、つまり鞍の歴史的研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on the historical research of saddles and equestrian equipment, wasn't it.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective curiosity. Slight smile in the voice—teacher noticing the pattern. Unhurried pacing. Giving him room to answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、生物の烏、つまりカラスの知能研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually worked on intelligence and cognition research in crows.
lines.style: Quiet steadiness. Direct, matter-of-fact. No defensiveness, just fact. Slight warmth underneath—he's not bothered by her testing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「瑤」、つまり瑤宮の地名研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on geographical research of the older character for Yao, wasn't it.
lines.style: Reflective, almost gentle. Slight knowing quality—she sees what's happening. Warm curiosity, not judgment. Careful enunciation of the character name.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、旧字「螢」、つまり蛍の生態研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched the ecology and behavior of fireflies using the older character.
lines.style: Earnest, grounded. Small breath before starting—he's listening to her pattern too. Clear, unhurried. Natural sincerity without strain.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、江戸時代の禄、つまり俸禄制度の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper dealt with stipend systems and official salaries during the Edo period, didn't it.
lines.style: Reflective tone, patient. The final question—teacher letting him have the last word. Slight lift of affection in her pacing. Giving him space.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中国宋代の鄭氏、つまり鄭家の系譜研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied genealogy and family lineage of the Zheng family during China's Song Dynasty.
lines.style: Earnest, grounded, present. Final answer with quiet clarity. Slight warmth at the close—he's enjoying this exchange now. Relaxed but attentive.
